alert_database-unavailable: Database information is unavailable, so its nodes cannot be listed.
alert_list-incomplete: The list may be incomplete: some data sources did not respond.
alert_filter-not-applied: Filters were not applied: the list may contain rows that do not match them.
alert_sort-not-applied: Sorting was not applied: rows are shown in arbitrary order.
alert_nodes-status-unreliable: Some nodes did not respond in time and may be shown as unavailable.
alert_disks-unavailable: Disks of unavailable nodes are not shown, and disk filters may skip such nodes.
alert_partial-data: Some data is unavailable: some values may be missing.
context_empty-with-issues: Nothing to show, but the data may be incomplete
title_data-issues: Data may be incomplete or inaccurate
